The session whose first midcap id equals the first midcap id of the query, and whose nautical day equals the query day, takes session rank 1 inside the top 5 on a temporal query. The eponym match without the noon split, or the noon split without the eponym, does not move the seat. The query midcap is an entity id already in the plan, not a new lexicon.
math_formula: session rank 1 if first_midcap(s)=first query midcap and nautical_day(s)=query day
rust_sketch: if temporal { if let Some(s)=sess_top5.find(|s| first_midcap(s)==q_mid && nautical(s)==q_day){ move s to sess[0]; } }
funnel: LoCoMo Temporal Session@1 is inside s5. LME temporal Turn@1 needs t10 (116) not only t5 (111); the turn inside the chosen session with the closest clock is moved to slot 1 when it is already in the top 10.
dedupe_note: Not regnal dating. Not incipit session identity (the first midcap must equal the query's, and the nautical day must match). Not S8-022 alone.
